column1: # REGISTER — mutation-proofs.wave6-graph.tsv     WAVE 6, GRAPH/DEAD-PARAMETER LANE
# Companion to `mutation-proofs.tsv` (FROZEN at 61 file-level rows) and to
# `mutation-proofs.partial-code.tsv` (the code wave's 17 row-level proofs). This file does not
# touch either. It carries the proofs for the guard ROWS this lane added or changed while closing
# `registers/OPEN-ITEMS.md` items 20 and 24. The unit is the ROW (a test function), not the file.
# EVERY CELL BELOW WAS RECORDED FROM EXECUTION, NOT PREDICTED. Each mutation was applied to a
# SUBJECT MODULE in the working tree (never to a test), the single named test id was run, the
# module was restored, and `git diff -- <module>` was checked empty afterwards. `observed` quotes
# the pytest status line and the first assertion line pytest printed.
# WHY EVERY ROW CARRIES A DECOY. A mutation that turns a guard red proves only that the guard is
# sensitive to something. The decoy is an edit in the SAME neighbourhood that does NOT introduce
# the defect class — a legitimate retuning, a rename, an equivalent rewrite — and it must stay
# green. A row with a mutation and no decoy is a claim about a guard, not a measurement of one.
# WHY ONE ROW IS MARKED DECORATIVE RATHER THAN PROVED.
# `test_every_dead_parameter_exemption_is_still_a_live_dead_parameter` iterates
# `DEAD_PARAMETER_EXEMPTIONS`, which item 20 has now emptied. Both of its loops are therefore
# empty and NO mutation to any module can turn it red — it is a tripwire armed only by a future
# exemption entry, not a live measurement. It is recorded as DECORATIVE, with the mutation that
# SHOULD have caught it and the green result that shows it did not, rather than given an invented
# proof or quietly deleted. The live half is the row above it, which is proved.
# DENOMINATOR
#   guard rows added or changed by this lane .......... 6
#     new     ... test_the_shipped_graphs_default_to_the_hybrid_03_calls_the_default   (test_graph_demo.py)
#     new     ... test_the_four_removed_cellsize_parameters_stay_removed               (test_render.py)
#     new     ... test_a_stale_positional_call_into_a_removed_cellsize_slot_raises     (test_render.py)
#     new     ... test_ulichney_ground_cover_is_shipped_and_node_wrappable             (test_graph_demo.py)
#     changed ... test_no_public_function_declares_a_parameter_it_never_reads          (test_render.py)
#     changed ... test_every_dead_parameter_exemption_is_still_a_live_dead_parameter   (test_render.py)
#   rows marked DECORATIVE with the failed proof shown . 1 of 6
#   mutations applied, run and restored ............... 7   (6 + a second, sharper one on the
#                                                            Ulichney row, kept because the first
#                                                            fired on emptiness rather than on the
#                                                            density dial it was written for)
#   decoys applied, run and restored .................. 6
#   IDENTITY: 6 rows == 5 proved + 1 decorative -> HOLDS
# ⚠️ THE SIXTH ROW IS NOT FROM THIS LANE'S BRIEF, AND WHY IT IS HERE IS PART OF THE RECORD. This
# lane's brief covered OPEN-ITEMS items 24 and 20 only. While it ran, the scatter lane closed item
# 22 by implementing Ulichney tiles in `scatter.py`, which turned
# `tests/test_graph_demo.py::test_ulichney_tiles_are_still_recommended_and_still_absent` RED — a
# tripwire firing correctly, in a file only this lane may write. Its own failure message names the
# fix ("delete this row and add a real reachability row to RECOMMENDED_CAPABILITIES"), so the row
# was promoted, `KNOWN_UNREACHABLE` emptied, and the census docstring changed from "eight
# reachable, one pinned" to "all nine reachable, none pinned". The promotion is guarded and proved
# below rather than taken on trust.
# Baseline for every trial below: the named test id GREEN on the unmutated tree.
# Restores are verified with `cmp` against a byte copy taken immediately before the edit, not with
# `git diff` — three other lanes were writing this tree at the same time, so a clean `git diff` for
# a whole file would not have been evidence about this lane's edit.
# FREEZE RULE: this file may grow only while this lane runs; anything found after it closes goes
# to OPEN-ITEMS.md like everything else.
